senses.zh_definition: Prateek：南亚人名，常见于印度；此处只能作为专有名词识别，不能确认为马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Prateek, a South Asian personal name, commonly a masculine given name; not established here as a Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang digunakan di Asia Selatan; bukan kata nama am bahasa Melayu yang dapat disahkan berdasarkan bahan yang tersedia.
senses.nuances: 人名通常写作 Prateek，首字母大写。词形可对应 Pratik；当前输入没有上下文，不能确认具体指称，也不能排除语料误收。因此不标为已获官方确认的马来语词条。人名对应关系见 [Pratik](https://www.behindthename.com/name/pratik)。以下搭配是人名使用框架，不代表已有频率统计。

etymology.historical_story: Prateek belongs to a South Asian naming tradition associated with Sanskrit pratīka. Historical Sanskrit dictionaries record meanings including outward form, image and symbol. This background explains an association of the name; it does not establish a Malay common noun meaning “symbol.” In Malay writing, an individual's name normally retains its chosen spelling. See [Monier-Williams](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/MWScan/MWScanpdf/mw0675-pratIka.pdf).
